title: Polynomial-Time Equivalence of Formula Encodings
statement: For every function $F$ from bit strings to CNF formulas over natural-number-indexed variables, the function sending $x$ to the fragment encoding of $F(x)$ is polynomial-time computable if and only if the function sending $x$ to the binary serialization of $F(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A function $F$ from bit strings to CNF formulas over natural-number-indexed variables.
